verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a browser-based Console playground for trying out the API, which gives runnable, in-browser exploration. A full API reference also exists (with .md mirrors). However, nothing shows the reference pages themselves are interactive or carry runnable try-it examples, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive reference with runnable per-endpoint examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: In the Console, you can use playground (platform.claude.com/playground) to try out the API in the browser and then generate API keys on the API keys page
.md mirrors of the full API reference (e.g. /docs/en/api/messages.md)
